article.title: AI Digital推出Ellie協助媒體規劃，投放仍由團隊審批及執行
article.title_en: AI Digital launches Ellie for media planning, with teams approving and launching campaigns
article.summary: 11月4日發布的Ellie把研究、受眾、媒體規劃及活動分析放在同一對話流程。
article.summary_en: Ellie’s November 4 launch connects research, audiences, media planning and analysis in one conversation.
highlights: Ellie協調專用代理，使用已接入Elevate的活動資料。
官方FAQ明示：Ellie不修改已投放活動，團隊負責批准與執行。
highlights_en: Ellie coordinates specialist agents using campaign data connected to Elevate.
The FAQ says Ellie does not change live campaigns; teams approve and activate them.
article.why: 代理商可評估連續保留研究與規劃背景，能否減少交接時遺漏客戶要求。
article.why_en: Agencies can assess whether shared research and planning context reduces lost client requirements.
article.next_step: 用一份已完成的brief比較建議，並核對資料覆蓋及批准責任。
article.next_step_en: Compare recommendations on a completed brief and check data coverage and sign-off responsibility.
article.detail: Ellie位於Elevate平台內，針對媒體工作串連受眾、規劃、預測及分析。官方指出，未接入Elevate報告的活動不在可見範圍；預測亦只是按歷史與可用庫存推算，沒有成效保證。新聞稿稱合資格合作客戶可使用，並非任何人免費取得的獨立工具。Ellie的產出交由策略人員批准，再由AI Digital代營運團隊投放，不能寫成自主操作廣告帳戶。
article.detail_en: Ellie works inside Elevate and cannot see campaigns outside connected reporting. Forecasts use history and available inventory, without guaranteed results. Access is tied to qualifying client partnerships. Strategists approve outputs and AI Digital’s managed-service team activates campaigns.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
